title: Your Film
logline: One sentence. What the film is about, not what happens in it.

higgsfield._: folder_id is what the web app filed the generations under. No image model and almost no video model accepts it over the API, so the desk enforces the one-folder rule by ledger and cast (see README), not by asking the API.

shots.title: Opening
shots.prompt: Camera, lens, move. HERO (@[hero](<element uuid>)) does one thing. Key light from @[plate-key-light](<element uuid>). 21:9, photoreal, anamorphic. No text anywhere in frame. REFERENCES — attach before generating: @[hero](<element uuid>); @[plate-key-light](<element uuid>).

ledger._: Every generation the desk submits is appended here with the project id, so it can be pulled back by id regardless of what the API can filter on.
